items.title: AI SEO workflows with Google AI Studio
items.summary: walk through using Google AI Studio to vibe-code three real SEO apps, a blog image generator, a keyword trend dashboard, and a content production workflow, including the prompts that worked, the ones that didn’t, and the 5 errors it took to get there. Plus an honest take on where AI Studio is genuinely useful, and where it’s still a prototyping toy that breaks production. For SEOs who want to stop waiting on dev tickets and start shipping their own tools.
